# DevDoctor

DevDoctor is a local developer-workstation resource manager (macOS and Linux).
It scans disk caches and offers interactive cleanup. All computation is local;
nothing leaves the machine.

- Docs (rendered): docs/
- Docs (repo source):
  - Tutorial (start here): https://github.com/katagun/devdoctor/blob/main/docs/tutorial.md
  - CLI reference and `scan --json` contract: https://github.com/katagun/devdoctor/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md
  - Web UI guide and `/api` surface: https://github.com/katagun/devdoctor/blob/main/docs/web-ui.md
  - Provider catalogue with risk levels: https://github.com/katagun/devdoctor/blob/main/docs/providers.md
  - Safety model: https://github.com/katagun/devdoctor/blob/main/docs/safety-model.md
  - FAQ ("why did my free space not change?"): https://github.com/katagun/devdoctor/blob/main/docs/faq.md
  - Docs for agents: https://github.com/katagun/devdoctor/blob/main/docs/agents.md
- Full text of all of the above in one file: llms-full.txt
- CLI: `devdoctor scan` (read-only), `devdoctor clean` (preview unless
  `--execute`), `devdoctor recipe` (commented-out script), `devdoctor serve`
  (local web UI). Risk tiers: safe / reclaimable / dangerous (skipped unless
  `--allow-dangerous`).
- Repo: https://github.com/katagun/devdoctor
